importing data
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

library(nycflights13)

```
```{r}
glimpse(weather)
```
```{r}
glimpse(flights)
```

##setting up variables
```{r}
ua_delays <- flights %>%
  filter(carrier == "UA")

ua_delays['late'] <- ua_delays$dep_delay >0

ua_delays['very_late'] <- ua_delays$dep_delay >30

ua_delays<- ua_delays  %>%
  select(-c(arr_time, sched_arr_time,tailnum,air_time, distance, ))
  
glimpse(ua_delays)
```
```{r}
weather_ua <- weather %>%
  select(-c(dewp, humid, wind_dir, wind_gust, pressure))

glimpse(weather_ua)
```

##Merge Data
```{r}
ua_flights_weather <- ua_delays %>%
  left_join(
    weather_ua,
    by = c("origin", "year", "month", "day", "hour")
  )

glimpse(weather_ua)
```
```{r}
ua_flights_weather %>%
  summarise(
    total_flights = n(),
    avg_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE), 
    sd_delay = sd(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
## dealing with missing values
```{r}
ua_flights_weather %>%
  summarise(
    total_flights = n(),
    dep_delay_miss = sum(is.na(dep_delay)),
    temp_miss = sum(is.na(temp)),
    wind_speed_miss = sum(is.na(wind_speed)),
    precip_miss = sum(is.na(precip)),
    visib_miss = sum(is.na(visib))
  )
```
total UA flights = 58,665
missing data
  dep_delay = 686
  temp = 311
  wind_speed = 321
  precip = 304
  visib = 304

keeping only rows without missing data
```{r}
ua_flights_weather <- ua_flights_weather %>%
  drop_na()

ua_flights_weather %>%
  summarise(
    total_flights = n(),
    dep_delay_miss = sum(is.na(dep_delay)),
    temp_miss = sum(is.na(temp)),
    wind_speed_miss = sum(is.na(wind_speed)),
    precip_miss = sum(is.na(precip)),
    visib_miss = sum(is.na(visib))
  )
```
  now only 57465 flights. Kept 97% of the original data.
